title: Mech suits: MA and MC variations
desc: Three new builds each for 821 MA Titan frame and MC Juggernaut (IMPROVE, no note): more detailed designs and their own textures, each forming, moving and attacking its own way.

takes.name: Plated Titan
takes.facts: dark frame under bevelled BR1 brick plates, sensor head, reactor, back exhausts, 4-finger hands; frame forms then plates fly in; one-two punch; two-fist ground pound; player pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Exo Frame
takes.facts: open V1 crystal exoskeleton, the player stands inside and his arms copy the mech's; struts trace out then crystals grow; hook + uppercut; leap to a one-knee landing; player pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Dome Titan
takes.facts: round R2 barrel body, glass dome cockpit, ball joints, arm blade + round shield; blooms from the core; blade slash edge-first with a trail; shield slam dome shockwave; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Siege Ape
takes.facts: hunched W1 brute, long arms, stacked pauldrons, block fists, thrusters; scan ring builds it; knuckle-walk; rear-up two-fist smash; thruster leap; zombie pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Rocket Juggernaut
takes.facts: R1 green cells, hover pads, 4-nozzle booster pack, rocket fists; parts fly in and spin into place; hover glide; rocket punch on a tether; spinning boost slam; villager pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126

takes.name: Breaker
takes.facts: H1 hex, horned helm, spiked pauldrons, plate skirt, two-handed war hammer; rains together top-down; plodding hammer drag; overhead smash face-first; 360 sweep; zombie pilot; form 1-24, board 24-35, move 36-76, attack 76-96, finisher 96-126
